name: camindo-cms-templates
description: Colors, completion and hover for (CMS:…) commands in camindo CMS templates (*.cms.php)

camindo.commandsFile.description: JSON file with the command definitions (tools/export-commands.php), absolute or relative to the workspace. Empty: the file shipped with the extension.

camindo.commandColor.description: Color of (CMS:…) commands, e.g. #a000a0. Empty: purple, lighter in dark themes.

camindo.phpColor.description: Color of PHP expressions inside commands ({$…}, $var), e.g. #ff8800. Empty: orange.
